fit.summary: Years of coordinating contractors, vendors, and schedules in retail, plus a CAPM; no construction employer yet.

bullets.text: Coordinated 4 contractors on an 8-week remodel of an occupied site, delivering $15K under a $120K budget
Scheduled deliveries from 35 vendors on a shared order calendar, cutting stockouts 30%
Coordinated 60 events a year, scheduling speakers, rooms, and staff

cover_letter.hook: Keeping subcontractors, deliveries, and site schedules lined up is the part of my current job I am best at, and I want to do it full time at Harbor Construction Group.
cover_letter.body:
At Maple Street Market I ran an 8-week remodel while the store stayed open, coordinating 4 contractors and finishing $15K under a $120K budget. I schedule deliveries from 35 vendors on a shared calendar, which cut stockouts 30%.

I earned my CAPM in 2025 to put a framework under what I had been doing by hand.
cover_letter.close: I would like to talk about how your coordinators split work across active jobs.

gaps: No construction employer yet; PMP is preferred and Dana holds the CAPM instead.
